decisions.reason: As a renamed successor to an already well-accepted trommel screen that has remained in the portfolio for years, it likely performs above aspiration and there is little reason for problemistic search away from it.

The multi-model mobile flail shredder line signals sustained commitment and, absent evidence of persistent underperformance, a mature German machinery firm would keep exploiting its installed capabilities and service network.

Although more niche, the stationary electric fine shredder fits the firm's strategic move toward tougher and more resource-saving stationary processing, so if it is still marketed in 2022 it likely meets aspirations well enough to retain.

This green-waste grinder still carries some overlap and portfolio-pruning risk, but its continued presence after the earlier withdrawal of Product C suggests it has found a viable niche and should be kept for now.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line matches the firm's core competencies, benefits from model-line commitment, and its survival indicates results likely close enough to aspiration to justify continuation.
